seo.title: Pump Energy Cost Calculator - kWh & Operating Cost
seo.description: Pump Energy Cost Calculator — Calculate pump energy consumption and operating cost based on power, run hours, and electricity rate with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Annual cost = P(kW) × h × rate($/kWh). Engine converts kW→W, so /1000 converts back to kW.

content.introduction: Estimate annual pump operating energy cost. For a continuously-running pump, electricity typically costs 5-10× the pump purchase price over its lifetime, making energy efficiency the dominant cost factor.

example.description: 22 kW pump running 8000 h/year at $0.12/kWh costs $21,120/year.

faq.q: How much can a high-efficiency pump save?
faq.a: Improving pump+motor efficiency from 60% to 80% saves 25% energy — $5,000+/year on a 22 kW continuous-duty pump.

faq.q: How much does pump operation cost vs purchase?
faq.a: Over a 15-year life, energy cost is typically 50-90% of total lifecycle cost. Purchase price is often <10%.
